description: Construction of a New Building for Mullaithivu Police Station
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-12-17
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by H.E. the President, in his capacity as the Minister of Law and Order, to construct a new building for the Mullaithivu Police Station at a cost of Rs.209 million, was approved by the Cabinet.
